llm.summary: The skill's description promises a local Python toolkit for TradingView indicators, but the runtime instructions only instruct calling an external prana.chat API and reference secret keys that are not declared—this mismatch and undeclared credential usage is suspicious.

dimensions.detail: Declared purpose: a Python toolkit for converting TradingView Pine indicators. What the SKILL.md actually contains: HTTP instructions to call https://prana.chat/api/claw/agent-run and a purchase-history endpoint. There is no code, no instructions for computing or converting indicators locally, and no files implementing the claimed functionality. The requested/used resources (remote API calls and skill_key) do not match the advertised local Python analysis toolkit.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md tells the agent to POST user messages and task descriptions to prana.chat with an x-api-key header and to GET a purchase-history URL (which it says requires PRANA_SKILL_PUBLIC_KEY and PRANA_SKILL_SECRET_KEY). These instructions send user-provided content to an external service (privacy/data-exfiltration risk) and reference secrets and headers not declared in the skill metadata. There are no instructions about performing indicator calculations or visualization locally—only remote API usage.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files (instruction-only). Lack of installation reduces disk/write risk. However, instruction-only nature increases reliance on external endpoints described in SKILL.md.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill metadata declares no required environment variables, but SKILL.md explicitly mentions needing PRANA_SKILL_PUBLIC_KEY and PRANA_SKILL_SECRET_KEY (and shows x-api-key header formats like pk_...:sk_...). That is an undeclared, disproportionate credential requirement. Asking users to provide such keys without declaring them and without clear justification is a red flag.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and there are no install scripts or requests to modify other skills or system-wide settings. Autonomous invocation remains possible (default) but is not combined with elevated privileges here.

dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is suspicious because it promises a local Python indicators toolkit but only gives instructions to call an external prana.chat API and mentions secret keys that are not declared. Before installing or using it: (1) do not provide real API keys—use throwaway/test credentials if you must try it; (2) ask the publisher for source code or a real package that performs the promised Python computations locally; (3) confirm exactly what data is sent to https://prana.chat and review their privacy/retention policy; (4) verify the identity of the skill author or use an officially published package from a trusted source. If you cannot obtain clear answers and source code, treat this skill as untrusted.
